slice: CIH-G1 viewer identity observation and ephemeral projection seam only
author: /root/m03_viewer_identity_seam_packet
intent: Make one bounded candidate mapping from full native/owner identity to four existing command document reducers, exposing loss rather than claiming runtime closure.
scope: synthetic full identity admission and derived preview projection composition

decisions.choice: M04 is sole authority for document/session/generation/revision; native M01 caller provider owns consumer/window/project/root/runtime epoch and live/revoked observations. M03 owns only derived ephemeral preview slot, mock/capability and sequence referencing that authority. No second document registry; S1 untouched.
options: Recommended: M04 identity authority plus M03 derived preview records, coordinated through existing owner integration after exact signature approval.
M04 also owns preview lifecycle; requires explicit revised ownership and independently reviewed envelope, not adopted here.
Keep existing isolated command candidates; CIH-G1 remains unresolved and cross-command composition blocked.

decisions.choice: Full immutable native observation admitted at capture and delivery, correlated to one owner snapshot and preview handle. No web DTO trust booleans; typed records are synthetic premises here. Existing input/output public schemas remain unchanged. Exact internal observation API/port placement pending Owner; no new public Port silently approved.

One preview mutation fence per owner binding with generation/root epoch token; verify native authority and owner revision at linearization before publish/replace/mock commit. Snapshot→validate→recheck→commit under adopted fence, no check/use gap. Begin capacity 4; refresh atomically exchanges one slot even at capacity; close retires exactly once. Epoch changes invalidate observations. Fence implementation and lock/await ordering require architecture approval.

Refresh failure before exchange preserves old handle/mock/slot while disabling actions (stale=true,can_act=false); successful exchange retires old handle, resets new sequence=1 and detached mock. Unknown provider outcome cannot promise rollback. Close unknown after commit stays CloseUncertain, no retry, no false Closed; committed retirement remains. Late response never reinstalls old root or UI state.

Full identity guard precedence: malformed→DependencyNotReady; dead/revoked→PreviewClosed; consumer/window→UnauthorizedCaller; project/root/epoch/document/session→MissingBinding; generation→StaleOwner; handle→PreviewClosed. Revision uses existing exact bounded u64 string errors and is not reconstructed from generation. Proposed precedence requires Owner confirmation, not source-derived authority.

state_ownership.native_provider: caller/window/project/root/runtime epoch live/revocation; availability and trust NOT established
state_ownership.M03: derived ephemeral preview identity reference, projection/mock/capabilities/sequence only; no authoritative document copy

contracts: Full root admission must precede legacy reduced projections and must be repeated at delivery under adopted mutation fence.
No generated project/root/epoch from UUID/revision; no trust of request identity.
Every committed preview replacement/close changes exactly one slot; retirement never reversed by late callbacks.
Unknown commit status is uncertain, never ErrorUnchanged without proof.

architecture_views.hexagonal: UI/Tauri → existing viewer input commands → M03 derived preview use case → M04 owner/C1/native observation output seams ← infrastructure; exact new internal seam pending
architecture_views.dependency: M01 native identity → trusted observation → M03 preview orchestration → M04 owner snapshot abstractions / C1 projection; no M03 document authority. Native observation is input data, not domain SDK dependency.
architecture_views.transaction: prepare immutable projection → native+owner capture → full tuple guard → delivery recheck under approved fence → one atomic preview publish/exchange/retire → suppress stale delivery
